Eligibility Criteria
Warrant Officer (Cipher)

Candidates must have passed Class 12th in Science with Physics, Mathematics, and English , along with a 2-year ITI course (NSQF Level 4 or above) in ICT, IT, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Instrumentation Technology.
Rifleman (Lineman Field)

Candidates must have passed Class 10th with 2 years of technical training from ITI . Alternatively, candidates can have a 2 or 3-year Diploma in Electronics Engineering, Electronics Mechanic, Electrical Engineering, Electrician Power Distribution, Electrician, Instrumentation Technology, Instrument Mechanic, Technician Power Electronic System, Technician Electronic System Design & Repair, Fibre to Home Technician, or OFC Technician.
Rifleman (Engineer Equipment Mechanic)

Candidates msut have passed Class 10th with 2 years of technical training from ITI in Power Electric Systems Mechanic or Mechanic Diesel. Alternatively, candidates can have a 2 or 3-year Diploma in Engineering Equipment Mechanic from a recognized institution.
Rifleman (Electrician Motor Vehicle)

Candidates msut have passed Class 10th with 2 years of technical training from ITI . Alternatively, candidates can have a 2 or 3-year Diploma in Electrician, Electrical Engineering, Technical, Power Electronics, or Communication System from a recognized institution.
Rifleman (Metalsmith)

Candidates must have passed Class 10th with 2 years of technical training from ITI . Alternatively, candidates can have a 2 or 3-year Diploma in Metalsmith or Metallurgy from a recognized institution.
Rifleman Store Keeper Technical (EME)
Candidates must have passed Class 10th from a recognized board or institution .
Rifleman (Welder)
Candidates must have passed Class 10th with 2 years of technical training from ITI . Alternatively, candidates can have a Diploma in Welder or Metallurgy from a recognized institution.
Warrant Officer (Operation Theatre Technician)
Candidates must have passed Class 12th and hold a minimum 2-year Diploma in Operation Theatre Technician .
Rifleman (Mason)
Candidates must have passed Class 10th , qualify the required Trade Test , and provide a self-certification/undertaking confirming at least 1 year of work experience in the relevant trade .
Rifleman (Electrical Fitter Signal)

Candidates must have passed Class 10th with 2 years of technical training from ITI . Alternatively, candidates can have a 2 or 3-year Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electrician Power Distribution, Electrician, Instrumentation Technology, Instrument Mechanic, Technician Power Electronic System, or Technician Electronic System Design & Repair.
Rifleman (Armorer)
Candidates must have passed Class 10th and hold an ITI certificate in the Welding trade from a recognized institution.
Rifleman (Recovery Vehicle Mechanic)

Candidates must have passed Class 10th and hold a 2-year ITI certificate in Recovery Vehicle Mechanic , along with a valid Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV)/Transport Vehicle Driving License . Alternatively, candidates with Class 10th pass and a valid HMV/Transport Vehicle Driving License are also eligible.
Havildar (Instrument Mechanic)

Candidates must have passed Class 10th with 2 years of technical training from ITI . Alternatively, candidates can have a 2 or 3-year Diploma in Instrument Mechanic, Instrument Technology, Electronic Mechanic, or Electronic Technology from a recognized institution.
Rifleman (Upholster)

Candidates must have passed Class 10th with 2 years of technical training from ITI . Alternatively, candidates can have a 2 or 3-year Diploma in Upholstery/Upholster Trade from a recognized institution.
Rifleman (Vehicle Mechanic)

Candidates must have passed Class 10th with a minimum 2 years of technical training from ITI . Alternatively, candidates can have a 2 or 3-year Diploma in Mechanic Motor Vehicle, Mechanic, Mechanic Diesel, Fitter, Mechanic Engineering Technology, or Automobile Engineering from a recognized institution.
Warrant Officer (Draughtsman)
Candidates must have passed Class 10th and hold a 3-year Diploma in Architectural Assistantship from any recognized Polytechnic College or Institution.
Warrant Officer (Physiotherapist)

Candidates must have passed Class 12th and hold a minimum 2-year Diploma in Physiotherapy . They must also have at least 1 year of work experience as a Physiotherapist in a recognized hospital or physiotherapy centre with a minimum capacity of 50 beds .
